plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Mandel Kramer is credited on 211 distinct recordings across 16 programs from 1940-06-30 through 1979-09-26. Documented roles include performer on 211 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Counterspy (performer on 60 recordings; 60 distinct recordings), Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar (performer on 60 recordings; 60 distinct recordings), CBS Radio Mystery Theater (performer on 51 recordings; 51 distinct recordings), X Minus One (performer on 12 recordings; 12 distinct recordings), Gang Busters (performer on 9 recordings; 9 distinct recordings), The Adventures of the Abbotts (performer on 3 recordings; 3 distinct recordings), The Chase (performer on 3 recordings; 3 distinct recordings), and The Falcon (performer on 3 recordings; 3 distinct recordings).

Documented character portrayals include Johnny Dollar (61 portrayals), Harry Peters (60 portrayals), and Sergeant Johnny Gleason (3 portrayals).
